Challenges

Selling to large enterprises is hard to do well.

What suppliers tell us gets in the way.

  • Opportunities depend on contactsHard to reach the right buyer at a large enterprise.
  • Opaque evaluationsNo visibility on how quotes were compared.
  • Slow PO follow-upsChasing buyers for order and delivery updates.
  • Paperwork, repeatedThe same documents submitted to every customer.

A fair, digital route to industrial buyers.
